clue.text: Minded about a favourite being reprimanded

indicators.note: the word for minded wraps around the other pieces, as about means surrounding

parts.note: to have minded something is to have cared about it
a favourite is a pet, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: Someone who minded having a favourite gets told off for it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts A PET inside CARED. To be CARPETED is British slang for being called in and reprimanded, originally on the boss's carpet.
explanation.definitionFit: Being carpeted is an informal idiom for getting a dressing-down from a superior.

clue.text: Misanthrope is married to surliness

parts.note: a cynic distrusts other people's motives, like a misanthrope

explanation.surface: A people-hater is wedded to bad temper.
explanation.definitionFit: Cynicism is a sneering distrust of others, close to sour surliness.

clue.text: Sighs, rent worked out being correct

indicators.note: the letters are worked out into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A tenant sighs over the rent but agrees it is correct.
explanation.definitionFit: Rightness is the state of being right or accurate.

clue.text: Ghostly English lake

parts.note: Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America

explanation.surface: A haunted lake in England.
explanation.definitionFit: Eerie means strange and frightening, as a ghost is.

clue.text: The head man, in a temper, ordered everyone out

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the run of clue words, in the middle of them

explanation.surface: A furious ruler clears the room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points into TEMPER ORDERED; 'everyone out' just completes the scene of a ruler throwing everyone out.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is the supreme ruler of an empire.

clue.text: Keep many a Greek character at home

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a crossword stand-in for many
eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: An instruction to hold plenty of Greek letters indoors.
explanation.definitionFit: To detain someone is to hold or keep them back.

clue.text: Minxes are spoilt — they ask a lot of questions

definitions.text: they ask a lot of questions

indicators.note: the letters are spoilt, losing their original order

explanation.surface: Pampered young women are full of questions.
explanation.definitionFit: Examiners set and ask the questions in a test.

clue.text: Cast's point of view

definitions.meaning: to cast a line is to fish, and fishing with rod and line is angling
a slant or perspective on something

explanation.definitionFit: Angle means to fish with a line and also a particular slant on a matter.

clue.text: A record player

parts.note: not the whole gramophone but the part that actually plays the disc

explanation.walkthrough: 'record player' suggests the whole machine; here it is the small part that runs in the groove.
explanation.definitionFit: A stylus traces the groove of a vinyl disc to play it.

clue.text: Decoration of a low joint

parts.note: the low joint is a body joint near the foot, not a seedy bar

explanation.walkthrough: 'low joint' suggests a disreputable bar, but it is the joint just above the foot.
explanation.definitionFit: An anklet is a bracelet or chain worn around the lower leg just above the foot.

clue.text: Soldiers with spirit turned round, coming to a river

indicators.note: the soldiers and the spirit together are read backwards, as if turned to face the other way

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Troops with a drink about-face on reaching a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned round' reverses REGIN, the Royal Engineers followed by GIN, giving the West African river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Niger is a major river of West Africa, flowing through Mali, Niger and Nigeria.

clue.text: Figure confined to the corner

parts.note: pent, as in pent-up, means shut in or confined
a corner is an angle

explanation.surface: Someone shut away in a corner, as a punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A pentangle is a five-pointed star, a geometric figure.

clue.text: Had claret produced specially for the church

indicators.note: the letters are produced in a special new arrangement

explanation.surface: A claret was laid on specially for the church.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathedral is the principal church of a diocese.

clue.text: Thought the Left quite the best

parts.note: an idea is a thought
L is the standard abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: Someone thinks the political Left is the finest.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideal describes something perfect, the best one could hope for.

clue.text: Thoroughly wet, the king becomes more difficult

parts.note: to steep something is to soak it thoroughly
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen; here it is read as the king's abbreviation Edwardus Rex

explanation.surface: A soaked monarch finds things getting harder.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is the royal cipher, standing for Edward Rex (king) as well as Elizabeth Regina.
explanation.definitionFit: A steeper slope is harder to climb, so steeper means more demanding.

clue.text: Going before quietly retiring

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly
receding means drawing back or retiring

explanation.surface: Someone slips out early without a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: Preceding means coming before in time or order.

clue.text: Join the revolutionary in rows

parts.note: to tie is to join
a red is a communist revolutionary

explanation.surface: An invitation to join a revolutionary who is quarrelling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in rows' looks like arguments, but it means arranged in layers.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiered seating is arranged in rising layers, one row above another.

clue.text: Call up at one about discharge

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for call is read upwards, that is backwards

parts.note: to name someone is to call them
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Someone is summoned at one o'clock about being dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: An emanation is something given off or issuing forth from a source.

clue.text: "When I am in the country I wish to ___ like the country." (Hazlitt

definitions.text: "When I am in the country I wish to ___ like the country." (Hazlitt

parts.words: "When I am in the country I wish to ___ like the country." (Hazlitt
parts.note: the missing verb from William Hazlitt's essay On Going a Journey, about living like plant life

explanation.walkthrough: A fill-in-the-blank quotation: Hazlitt wrote that in the country he wished to live as passively as the plants around him.
explanation.definitionFit: To vegetate is to live a dull, inactive life, like a plant.

clue.text: Stares wildly, say

indicators.note: the letters of the clue word are thrown about wildly into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone glares wildly, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' looks like the usual signal for an example, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To assert something is to state or declare it.

clue.text: A scoop for the down-to earth individual

definitions.text: A scoop for the down-to earth individual

parts.words: A scoop for the down-to earth individual
parts.note: the down-to-earth person is literally down in the soil, a gardener, whose scoop is a small hand tool

explanation.walkthrough: 'down-to-earth' means practical, but here it is literal: someone down on the earth, gardening.
explanation.definitionFit: A trowel is a small hand tool with a scoop-shaped blade for digging.

clue.text: A charge can be made after a certain time

parts.note: post- is a prefix meaning after
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: A fee is levied once a deadline has passed.
explanation.definitionFit: Postage is the fee paid for sending mail.

clue.text: Didn't stop sound urban development

indicators.note: sound signals that the words are judged by how they are spoken

parts.note: pressed on means carried on without stopping

explanation.surface: Building in a town carried on soundly.
explanation.walkthrough: PRESTON is a town in Lancashire, northern England, granted city status in 2002.
explanation.definitionFit: Preston is a large Lancashire town, an urban settlement that grew up in the industrial era.

clue.text: Warning a worker about fighting

indicators.note: the insect wraps around the conflict, as about means surrounding

parts.note: a worker bee
war is fighting

explanation.surface: A labourer is cautioned about conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: Beware! is a cry of caution to someone in danger.

clue.text: Supply directions expected

parts.note: E and N are east and north, two compass directions
something due is expected, like a train

explanation.surface: Deliveries arrive on schedule along given routes.
explanation.definitionFit: To endue is to endow or provide someone with a quality.

clue.text: Birds that mean nothing to some sportsmen

definitions.meaning: in cricket a batsman out without scoring makes a nought

explanation.definitionFit: Ducks are waterbirds, and in cricket a duck is a score of zero.

clue.text: Stretch of superior country

parts.note: over means above or superior
a state is a country

explanation.surface: A tract of land in a superior nation.
explanation.definitionFit: To stretch the truth is to exaggerate it.

clue.text: Shelter provided in the street for wintry weather

indicators.note: the word for shelter is placed in the abbreviation for street

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street
lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind

explanation.surface: A shelter is set up on the street against the cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleet is a mix of rain and snow falling in cold weather.

clue.text: He plans for a constructive follow-up

definitions.text: He plans for a constructive follow-up

parts.words: He plans for a constructive follow-up
parts.note: the planner here is someone who draws up designs that builders then follow

explanation.walkthrough: The plans are building plans, and the constructive follow-up is the construction work that comes after them.
explanation.definitionFit: An architect designs buildings for builders to construct.

clue.text: She swore she'd take a taxi rather than walk

definitions.text: She swore she'd take a taxi rather than walk

parts.words: She swore she'd take a taxi rather than walk
parts.note: the flower girl in Shaw's Pygmalion shocks society with 'Walk! Not bloody likely. I am going in a taxi'

explanation.walkthrough: The heroine of Shaw's Pygmalion and My Fair Lady swears in polite company when asked if she is walking home.
explanation.definitionFit: Doolittle is the flower girl of Pygmalion whose taxi line caused a scandal.

clue.text: An American naval officer on the staff?

definitions.meaning: the lowest commissioned rank in the US Navy
a flag flown on a flagstaff

explanation.definitionFit: Ensign is both a junior US naval rank and a flag, flown on a staff.

clue.text: A case made of cane isn't bad

indicators.note: the letters are treated badly and come out in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A basket woven from cane is not a poor one.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance is an example, a case in point.
